info.title: api_v2
info.description: Public markdown content, categories and search text, and employee-authenticated editor operations. Editor reads, writes, and the version token require a GitHub-authenticated govtech-bb organization member session.

previewToken.name: x-preview-token
previewToken.description: The site's PREVIEW_SECRET, sent server to server. Optional on site reads; with it, `preview` content is served too.

editorSession.name: better-auth.session_token
editorSession.description: HTTP-only employee session cookie; Secure-prefixed in production.

get.summary: Get a public page by its url
get.description: The site's read. A page is served only when it and every page above it (by `parent_id`) are visible: public, or preview too with the preview token. `hide_start_links` is set when the page's `start` sub-page is not. A bare `/<slug>` with no page of its own redirects (301) to the one visible page with that slug.

frontmatter.description: The stored frontmatter, with the page's title and description (columns of their own) put back.

body_markdown.description: The page body as written. The site sanitises and renders it.

form_id.description: The form a Start link with no href of its own opens, or null. Whether the form is open is the forms API's to say.

hide_start_links.description: True when the page's `start` sub-page is hidden from this viewer: the site removes the Start link and counts "There are N ways…" down.

breadcrumbs.description: The full trail, current page included, Home not: the category (and its parent, for a subcategory), then the pages above this one.

published_at.description: When the page first went public (seeded from landing's `publish_date`); null until it has.

updated_at.description: The page's last save, visibility changes included: the site's "Last updated" line.

post.description: Requires an employee session and the editor's Origin header.

parent_id.description: The page this one sits beneath, in the same category; null for a page at the root of its category, which is what the category lists.

published_at.description: When the page first went public; null until it has.

updated_at.description: Millisecond precision, and exactly the value to send back in `if-updated-at` on the next save.

get.description: In order, each with its subcategories. A category is listed when it or one of its subcategories has a visible page at its root.

get.summary: A category and what it lists
get.description: Its subcategories and the visible pages at its root. 404 when it lists nothing.

parent.description: The category this is a subcategory of, or null.

subcategories.description: Those with something to list, in order.

digital.description: It has a form, or its frontmatter says it is digital.

pages.description: The pages at the category's root, A to Z.

get.description: Every page the catalog lists, with its keywords and its body as plain-text chunks.

digital.description: It has a form, or its frontmatter says it is digital.

chunks.description: The body as plain text, split at its headings, in order. Joined with spaces (heading, then body, skipping empties) they are the whole body's text.

get.description: The editor's read: any visibility, markdown included.

parent_id.description: The page this one sits beneath, in the same category; null for a page at the root of its category, which is what the category lists.

published_at.description: When the page first went public; null until it has.

updated_at.description: Millisecond precision, and exactly the value to send back in `if-updated-at` on the next save.

put.description: Requires an employee session and the editor's Origin header. Send the `updated_at` you last read in the `if-updated-at` header. If the stored row has moved on since, the save is refused with a 409 rather than silently discarding whoever wrote first.

parameters.name: if-updated-at
parameters.description: The `updated_at` this client last read. Omit to accept whatever is stored.

parent_id.description: The page this one sits beneath, in the same category; null for a page at the root of its category, which is what the category lists.

published_at.description: When the page first went public; null until it has.

updated_at.description: Millisecond precision, and exactly the value to send back in `if-updated-at` on the next save.

delete.description: Requires an employee session and the editor's Origin header. A page with sub-pages is refused (422) until they are moved or deleted.

get.description: The editor's index, ordered by title. A categorised page at the root of its category is an entry, and every page beneath it by `parent_id` belongs to it.

form_id.description: The entry page's form, else its `/start` page's.

page_count.description: The entry page plus every page below it.

updated_at.description: The latest change across those pages.

get.summary: A version token for the whole estate
get.description: `change_events` is append-only and gets a row on every write, so its count and newest timestamp identify the state of everything without reading any of it. Clients poll this and refetch only when it moves.
Better Auth owns the endpoints under this prefix. Responses are never cached.
